entries.f364c242e8ef7916: Under the corporate philosophy "Create together, communicate together," the company is working on "business restructuring" and "improving profitability" and depicts a V-shaped recovery toward fundamentally strengthening profitability and establishing a continuing surplus foundation. In the printing business, it will continue negotiations with customers for appropriate pricing, review unprofitable transactions, raise the in-house production ratio by consolidating bases at the Sayama Plant, expand sales of high-value-added products in which it participates from the planning and production stages, and invest management resources in the pharmaceutical and OTC packaging materials and package field handled by its consolidated subsidiary Shinmura Printing Co., Ltd. as a growth area. In the industrial materials and electronic components manufacturing business, it will also expand application areas to medical care and healthcare and industrial sensors, shift newspaper printing to an asset-light collaborative structure, expand sales of paper flexible packaging, and review the real estate leasing and other businesses.
